messages:
maria_account_exec: Heads up team: Helios Pharma sent an RFP this morning. They want: a capabilities matrix, FedRAMP readiness notes, POC scope for PHI-limited data, pricing for a 6-month pilot + annual Dedicated pricing, and the SOC reports. They also requested an on-prem appliance option. Can we triage owners?

thomas_se: I can take the capability matrix & technical writeup. I9ll enumerate features (streaming, function call, embeddings, reranker), note GA vs beta, and call out model size/latency tradeoffs. Also will add a row for on-prem appliance: we9re not shipping an appliance product, but Private (customer-hosted) + air-gapped bundle could be proposed.

leah_solutions: I9ll own the POC plan. For PHI we'll need the sanitized dataset + an isolated VPC. Suggest: 1 week setup smoke (connectivity + small test set), 3 weeks functional + accuracy checks, 2 weeks load & cost tuning. Need Helios expected peak QPS and typical tokens per response to size.

nina_compliance: I9ll run the compliance packet. Quick notes: SOC2 Type II available; we9re working towards FedRAMP readiness (gap list available); support for customer KMS & VPC; data retention/deletion policy documented. I9ll attach certs and draft FedRAMP gap responses. Flag: FedRAMP moderate authorization needs an ATO holder or partner; we need legal to confirm approach.

sam_ops: For Dedicated pricing, are they asking for GPU-hour or flat monthly commits? If they want a 6-month pilot number, I can give a reserve + overage cadence. Also on the on-prem ask: infra would want to evaluate network isolation & HSM access (HSM may be doable with customer HSM but needs infra + legal signoff).

legal-bot: New file uploaded: https://drive.redwood/helios/rfp/1765130001/helios-rfp-raw.pdf (uploader: maria_account_exec)

thomas_se: Uploaded capability matrix draft: https://drive.redwood/helios/rfp/1765130001/capability-matrix-v0.xlsx. Notes in the sheet: "On-prem appliance = Not offered; propose Private deployment with air-gap packaging"; "FedRAMP = work-in-progress; list of compensating controls included"; "Model quantization = available on Dedicated, limited GA on Hosted". Please annotate gaps and owners.

leah_solutions: POC skeleton: 

- Week 0: contract + NDA + network whitelisting
- Week 1: smoke (connectivity, auth, basic prompts)
- Weeks 2-4: functional tests with sanitized clinical prompts (accuracy, hallucination checks)
- Weeks 5-6: throughput & failover testing (simulate regional failover)
- Deliverables: test report, cost/performance tuning notes, ops runbook

leah_solutions: Need Helios to provide sample prompt set and indicate max allowed token length for responses.

nina_compliance: Uploaded compliance pack: https://drive.redwood/helios/rfp/1765130001/compliance-bundle-v1.zip. Contains redacted SOC2, encryption architecture diagram, data-flow for PHI, and retention policy. I added a FedRAMP gap spreadsheet and highlighted items needing legal & infra: moderate impact controls, persistent backup residency, HSM attestation.

maria_account_exec: Thanks. Thomas, Sam: can you put a 6-month pilot price row in the matrix (pilot commit & overage rate) and an annual Dedicated commit number? Include implementation services (one-time) and optional compliance add-on (audit support). Also add an estimate for Private deployment licensing.

thomas_se: Done in v1.6 of the matrix: Pilot = monthly reserved equivalent priced at 30% of annual commit pro-rata; overage billed at hosted per-token rate + 15%. Added implementation services (3 engineer-weeks) and optional compliance retainer.

sam_ops: Ops estimate: for 250 qps with 200 avg tokens/response -> approx 2x A40s for pilot with 25% headroom. Annual commit for production (1k qps) -> 8x A100 equivalent. Will include network & HSM integration effort estimate.

leah_solutions: For the POC acceptance criteria, propose: latency p95 under 350ms for standard prompts, accuracy metrics (BLEU/F1 threshold or domain-specific) on provided test set, no PHI leakage on audit sampling, and successful KV cache behavior under load.

nina_compliance: Legal question: Helios asked for indemnity language around PHI breaches and a clause on data residency for backups to remain in EU. Looping Legal.

legal-bot: New ticket created: LEGAL-1427 (owner: legal@redwood) re: indemnity and HSM attestation requirements.

maria_account_exec: Action items: thomas 9 finalize matrix + technical summary; leah 9 finalize POC plan + acceptance criteria; nina 9 finalize compliance packet + FedRAMP gap answers; sam 9 finalize sizing + ops estimate; I9ll consolidate and return to Helios by COB tomorrow. Please flag anything that needs exec review.

thomas_se: Will post v2 matrix here when ready. Also adding short 150-word positioning blurb: "Redwood offers a unified inference runtime across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes. For regulated workloads, Private deployments with customer-managed KMS and audit logging satisfy isolation and control needs while our runtime and autoscaling options make cost predictable."

leah_solutions: I'll add the POC calendar invite once Helios confirms availability.

nina_compliance: Scheduling a sync with infra for HSM feasibility tomorrow AM.

legal-bot: Reminder: follow-up to Helios RFP in 24 hours (thread 1765130001).
